test_world: Isolated disposable Linux world; Peaceful explicitly set before client join.

observations.anvil: Renamed one iron sword to VCF Linux Blade, delivered it, and displayed level 4 after starting at level 5; console count remained one sword.
observations.smithing: Consumed one upgrade template, one diamond sword and one netherite ingot; delivered exactly one netherite sword, verified by read-only console count queries.
observations.stonecutter: Selected stone bricks, consumed one of two stone and delivered one brick. SDK close returned the unused stone. A later compass-triggered session preserved one unfinished stone through disconnect/reconnect.
observations.loom: Consumed one white banner and one red dye; delivered one white banner with visible Red Saltire metadata. Console confirmed one banner and no dye.
observations.cartography: Created a map with the vanilla empty-map interaction, expanded it with one paper, and delivered Map 1 at level 1/4. Console confirmed one map and no paper.
observations.grindstone: Shift-click removed Sharpness I from the named iron sword and Unbreaking I from the netherite sword. Later ordinary clicks succeeded on both. Name persisted and XP bar visibly increased; exact XP was not measured. Initial ordinary-click rejection remains unresolved.
observations.inventory2x2: Opened the real shared inventory. SDK close returned zero tickets while the actual inventory remained open until client closure; no ingredient transfer performed through this entry in this exact run.
observations.armor: Equipped an iron helmet in the head slot; it persisted when the inventory reopened through another entry.
observations.offhand: Equipped one shield in the offhand; it persisted through subsequent inventory opening and disconnect.
observations.recipebook: Selected sticks using eight planks, delivered four sticks using two planks, then disconnected with six planks still in the grid. Reconnect count queries confirmed six planks and four sticks.

counter_limit: Zero SDK failure callbacks does not certify native transaction success; the initial grindstone request did not complete despite this counter remaining zero.

unexpected_observations.detail: First ordinary-click extraction displayed an unenchanted preview but returned no output; input stayed enchanted and returned on close. Shift-click and later ordinary-click repetitions succeeded. Cause not established; no claim this is fixed.

One repetition combined Escape and hotbar selection too quickly; the enchant targeted the other held sword. The unenchanted inserted sword correctly produced no output. Excluded from transformation evidence.

not_qualified: Custom recipes, costs, item ownership or transactions
Exact grindstone XP, curses and repair combinations
Arbitrary Pterodactyl images or Onistone runtime builds
